summary: Today's pick in India is to buy Tata Consultancy Services shares for delivery; today's pick in America is to buy Nu Holdings with strict limits because short-term outcome remains mostly noise. Analysts are discussing Honasa Consumer's stock performance, noting it is up significantly year-to-date but down from its all-time high, and suggest waiting for a pullback to improve risk-reward. They also note that initial public offerings are generally not accessible to small retail accounts in either the US or India due to high minimum investment requirements set by underwriters.
